# Analyze test non-7 components, infer key-row colors and generate masked grid.
# The key is the 3x3 area bounded by color-3 lines in the upper-left.
key=t[:3][:3] if False else [row[:3] for row in t[:3]]
row_counts=[sum(v not in (0,7) for v in row) for row in key]
key_rows=[i for i,n in enumerate(row_counts) if n==max(row_counts)]
required={key[i][j] for i in key_rows for j in range(3) if key[i][j] not in (0,7)}
key_rows,row_counts,required, key

steps.input:
out=[r[:] for r in t]
erased=[]
for k,cc in enumerate(comps(t)):
 xs=[x for x,y in cc]; ys=[y for x,y in cc]
 colors={t[x][y] for x,y in cc if t[x][y] not in (0,7)}
 bbox=(min(xs),min(ys),max(xs),max(ys))
 # preserve clue component in upper-left
 is_key=max(xs)<=3 and max(ys)<=3
 if not is_key and required<=colors:
  erased.append((k,bbox,colors,len(cc)))
  for x,y in cc: out[x][y]=7
print('erased',erased)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
